Code block inside a blockquote keeps its line indentation

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<blockquote><pre><code>line1\n    line2 indented</code></pre></blockquote>")
puts result.inspect
```
